evidence_class: Static source/contract assessment; active proof outcome UNVERIFIED
modular_facts_available: Global null expresses effect boundaries, not return-value correctness.

Reader posts constrain progress/bounds and EOF implies Position=length; they do not specify which byte/scalar produces ASCII/nonASCII/Invalid, which ASCII Value, exact width or the converse EOF condition.

Generic Space/ScanString/Scan posts give progress, node bounds and successful-node coordinates relative to consumed region. They do not characterize recognized grammar, exact failure point, whitespace bytes, token kind or source contents.
Raw Parse post Within permits Missing for every input; it cannot modularly entail literal arrays/integers/strings or exact BOM/token coordinates.

Public ProducerValues Parse has only Global null. Field/Element/Count posts give limited coordinate safety, Slice gives length, UTF8Width gives extent. They do not entail actual literal fixture results.

Visible expression functions IsNull/Present/OriginalExactJSON can unfold definitions, but their opaque argument operations still need semantic facts. Original_Node local post maps an already-known generic node; it cannot manufacture known token kinds.
not_available_modularly: Literal Parse acceptance/refusal/forms/exact coordinates; last-key-wins/count/equality/escape semantics; numeric rendering/negativezero/nonfinite/Truth/Quote/PythonString literal results.
Claim that actual compiler will fail these assertions: proof-body visibility/inlining and instance specialization may expose more than bare modular contracts; inspect actual report first.
actionable_if_actual_report_fails: Classify actual failures by reader/wrapper legality/global/progress, grammar invariants, concrete semantic controls, untouched numeric/render bodies; preserve complete report and each body status before selecting repair.

First add truthful exact source-reader correspondence: characterize kind/value/next offset through analyzed byte/scalar reader functions; enforce valid/invalid/EOF distinctions without adding accepted-domain preconditions. Prove both actual readers and every wrapper instance.

Add an executable or Ghost grammar denotation over the same full source/Count domain with explicit success/failure/end/token-kind relation, then prove Scan/Parse soundness and completeness including invalid encoding and full consumption. Do not treat shared helpers as an independent oracle; relate denotation to original semantics separately.

Strengthen public parser/selector/text/numeric/render postconditions only with facts their analyzed bodies establish. Expose complete source/Node relations, duplicate resolution and exact numeric rendering where asserted. No finite-literal whitelist contracts, asserted axioms or freshly assumed expected values.

Alternatively investigate explicit proof-body exposure for nonrecursive local adapters/helpers under installed-tool-supported facilities after exact review. Retain every body and full semantic assertion; do not assume recursive grammar or large numeric algorithms inline successfully. Body exposure is an engineering option, not a guarantee.

Keep fixture expectations fixed and add meaningful independent failure-position/reader-invalid/full-consumption controls to detect weakened semantics; never weaken current semantic assertions because contracts are insufficient.
Use new immutable diagnosed successor only after actual terminal report. No unchanged repeat of current large proof, solver increase, body exclusion, new Off/Assume/justification or product apply.
important_limit: A zero-unproved report on structural contracts alone cannot discharge universal semantic equivalence. Conversely missing semantic postconditions are proof-interface gaps, not demonstrated implementation bugs or universal tool infeasibility.

No numeric result derived or tool prediction
